## The Resonating Self: the theory behind the practice

Total Health works from *The Resonating Self*, my ontology of consciousness as
resonance. The perceptual time threshold $\tau$ is the shortest duration
within which two stimuli are still experienced as one moment. In RTC that
threshold is not a by-product of perception but the base unit of the model.

$$E_m = \frac{1}{\tau^3}$$

The same five measurements produce a paradox on a linear scale, and a straight
line with slope $-3$ on a log-log scale.

```{r}
#| label: fig-mind-energy-en
#| fig-cap: "Mind-Energy law: log-log check across five perceptual states."
tau <- c(0.100, 0.080, 0.062, 0.050, 0.042)
Em  <- 1 / tau^3
fit <- lm(log(Em) ~ log(tau))

plot(log(tau), log(Em), pch = 19, col = "#0099c8",
     xlab = "ln tau", ylab = "ln Em")
abline(fit, col = "#00549c")
```

The slope comes out at `r round(coef(fit)[["log(tau)"]], 3)`, as the law predicts.
